stops.note: a variant of cupa 'tub, cask'; the 4th-century Roman glass Lycurgus Cup in the British Museum changes colour from green to red when lit from within
borrowed into Old English as cuppe and reinforced by Old French coupe; the FA Cup, first contested in 1871-72, is the oldest national football competition in the world

current_meaning: a small bowl-shaped container for drinking from; a trophy
